title: Insurance Claim Intake (6 Fields)
description: Extracts typed values from a motor claim note: incident date, submission timestamp, repair estimate, passenger count, claim type and whether injuries were reported.
context: Claim CLM-88213. Policyholder Dana Okafor reports a rear-end collision on 14 March 2026 at about 5:40pm on the A40. Repair estimate from Westway Motors: £2,350.50. Excess on the policy is £250. Two passengers, no injuries reported. Claim submitted online 2026-03-16 at 09:12:30.

passenger_count.description: Number of passengers in the policyholder's vehicle
